name: Hard Qualification Evidence Resolver
purpose: Fail-closed resolver for mandatory licences, certificates, legal authorisations and non-trainable qualifications before a candidate can enter active recommended results.

rules.locationGatePrecedence: locationEligibility must still be ba-area or remote-ok; qualification resolution never overrides reject-distance or unknown location

activeFeedInvariant: A role with a mandatory qualification may be active only when qualificationEligibility is eligible or trainable and canonical evidence confirms that status.

examples.case: mandatory §21 electrical qualification, candidate evidence absent
mandatory certificate wording unclear between index and detail
